pages.title: A Helping Hand
pages.text: Automate a repeated action; electron tubes and brass sheets support precision actuators.

pages.title: Getting started
pages.text: Supply its held item and rotation; wrench it to switch use/attack modes. A committed supported action must change the world/target; an empty swing is insufficient.

pages.title: Related possibilities
pages.text: Power a Deployer and provide its held item; wrench it to switch right/left-click mode. Imitate supported placement, use, harvest or attack interactions.

pages.title: Related possibilities
pages.text: Have a Deployer holding a Wrench interact with the Train Station. Automate station assembly/disassembly.
